lines.text: Every January, Ben promised to hike more.
By March, his boots were back in the closet.
This year he tried something else.
On New Year's Day, many state parks run guided First Day Hikes, often free.
Check your state parks website, sign up, and go.
Then pick one new park every month, and log each visit with a stamp or sticker.
By spring, Ben had four parks on his map.
Save this for New Year's Day.
